memento mori.cn: 该博物馆的“向死而生”展览提醒游客生命的脆弱。

merchant bank.en: The merchant bank secured the project by underwriting the company's initial public offering.
merchant bank.cn: 该投资银行通过承销该公司的首次公开募股为该项目提供担保。

mercy killing.en: The controversial practice of mercy killing remains a deeply divisive ethical issue in modern society.
mercy killing.cn: 安乐死的争议性做法仍是现代社会极具分歧的伦理难题。

metal fatigue.en: The aircraft's wing suffered metal fatigue after years of repeated takeoffs and landings.
metal fatigue.cn: 飞机机翼因多年反复起降导致金属疲劳。

milk round.en: The milk round was delayed due to heavy traffic on the main road.
milk round.cn: 因主干道交通拥堵，送奶车延误了。

minimal pair.en: The minimal pair 'pat' and 'bat' demonstrates how a single sound change alters the word's meaning entirely.

minority government.en: The minority government secured passage by negotiating with opposition parties.
minority government.cn: 少数派政府通过与反对党协商得以通过法案。

miscarriage of justice.en: The court's decision was a miscarriage of justice that left the innocent man in prison for years.
miscarriage of justice.cn: 法院的判决是司法不公，致使无辜者入狱多年。

mission statement.en: The company's mission statement clearly outlines its commitment to sustainable development and social responsibility.
mission statement.cn: 该公司的使命宣言明确阐述了其对可持续发展和社会责任的承诺。

mistaken identity.en: He was shot in what seems to have been a case of mistaken identity.
mistaken identity.cn: 他像是被人认错了而遭到枪击的。

mixed bag.en: The results were a mixed bag, with some excellent projects but also several failures.
mixed bag.cn: 结果好坏参半，既有优秀的项目也有失败的案例。

mixed blessing.en: The new technology is a mixed blessing, offering convenience while introducing significant security risks.
mixed blessing.cn: 这项新技术是一把双刃剑，既便利又带来重大安全风险。

mixed metaphor.en: His speech was a mixed metaphor, confusing the audience with contradictory imagery.
mixed metaphor.cn: 他的演讲是混杂比喻，以矛盾的意象令听众感到困惑。

modus operandi.en: The detective deduced the killer's modus operandi from the crime scene evidence.
modus operandi.cn: 侦探根据犯罪现场证据推断出凶手的作案手法。

modus vivendi.en: They reached a modus vivendi to resolve their ongoing dispute peacefully.
modus vivendi.cn: 他们达成了一项妥协，以和平方式解决持续的争端。

money-back guarantee.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee if you aren't satisfied within thirty days.
money-back guarantee.cn: 如三十天内不满意，本店提供退款保证。

monkey business.en: The politician's monkey business was exposed when the scandal broke.
monkey business.cn: 该政客的不正当行为在丑闻爆发时败露。

monounsaturated fat.en: Consuming monounsaturated fat can help lower bad cholesterol levels effectively.
monounsaturated fat.cn: 摄入单不饱和脂肪可有效降低坏胆固醇水平。

moot court.en: The moot court debate focused on complex legal precedents that challenged traditional judicial interpretations.
moot court.cn: 模拟法庭辩论聚焦于挑战传统司法判例的复杂先例。

moral fibre.en: Her moral fibre was tested when she faced the temptation to steal from her employer.
moral fibre.cn: 当她面临从雇主处偷窃的诱惑时，她的道德操守受到了考验。

moral majority.en: The moral majority supports this policy despite their economic concerns.
moral majority.cn: 尽管存在经济方面的担忧，道德多数派仍支持该政策。

moral support.en: My sister came along just to give me some moral support.
moral support.cn: 我姐姐只是过来给我一些道义上的支持。

moral victory.en: The team secured a moral victory by outlasting their exhausted opponents in the final match.
moral victory.cn: 该队在决赛中凭借耐力战胜了疲惫的对手，赢得了道德上的胜利。

morality play.en: The morality play served as a powerful tool to teach ethical lessons through dramatic storytelling.
morality play.cn: 道德剧通过戏剧化的故事讲述，成为传授伦理教训的有力工具。

morning-after pill.en: She took the morning-after pill immediately after her accident.
morning-after pill.cn: 事故发生后，她立即服用了紧急避孕药。

most favoured nation.en: As a most favoured nation, the country enjoys equal trade privileges with all others.
most favoured nation.cn: 作为最惠国，该国享有与其他国家平等的贸易特权。

motor neuron.en: The damaged motor neuron failed to transmit signals, causing sudden muscle paralysis.
motor neuron.cn: 受损的运动神经元无法传递信号，导致肌肉突然瘫痪。

motor neuron disease.en: The patient's motor neuron disease has progressed rapidly, causing severe muscle weakness.
motor neuron disease.cn: 该患者运动神经元病进展迅速，导致严重肌无力。

mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.en: The rescuer performed mouth-to-mouth resuscitation until the victim regained breathing.
mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.cn: 施救者对受害者进行口对口人工呼吸，直至其恢复呼吸。

mummy's boy.en: Critics often label him a mummy's boy for his inability to make tough decisions alone.
mummy's boy.cn: 批评者常因其无法独自做出艰难决定而指责他是个‘巨婴’。

musical director.en: The orchestra's musical director conducted the symphony with remarkable precision.
musical director.cn: 乐团指挥以非凡的精准度演绎了这部交响乐。

mutatis mutandis.en: The same contract, mutatis mutandis, will be given to each employee (= the contract is basically the same for everybody, but the names, etc. are changed).
mutatis mutandis.cn: 把姓名等细节稍作修改之后,同一份合同将发给每个员工人手一份。

mystery shopper.en: The mystery shopper evaluated the service quality anonymously.
mystery shopper.cn: 神秘顾客匿名评估了服务质量。

nautical mile.en: The ship adjusted its course by exactly one nautical mile to avoid the storm.
nautical mile.cn: 该船调整航向一海里以避开风暴。

near miss.en: He should have won the match—it was a near miss.
near miss.cn: 这场比赛就该是他赢的——真是功亏一篑。

negative equity.en: The house's negative equity means we owe more than its current market value.
negative equity.cn: 该房产的负值权益意味着我们欠的钱超过了其当前市场价值。

neighbourhood watch.en: The neighbourhood watch program has significantly reduced crime in our community.
neighbourhood watch.cn: 社区守望计划显著降低了本社区的犯罪率。

nervous breakdown.en: She suffered a severe nervous breakdown after the relentless work pressure.
nervous breakdown.cn: 她在持续的工作压力下精神崩溃。

news ticker.en: The breaking news ticker on the screen updates every few seconds.
news ticker.cn: 屏幕上的滚动新闻条每隔几秒更新一次。

no-fly zone.en: The no-fly zone effectively blocked all enemy aircraft from entering the territory.
no-fly zone.cn: 禁飞区有效阻止了所有敌机进入该地区。

no-go area.en: Some clubs are no-go areas for people over 30.
no-go area.cn: 对于 30 岁以上的人来说,有些俱乐部是禁区。

noble gas.en: The noble gas argon is frequently used to create an inert atmosphere in welding.
noble gas.cn: 氩气常用于焊接时制造惰性气氛。

noblesse oblige.en: The noblesse oblige means that true luxury demands genuine elegance.
noblesse oblige.cn: 贵族风范意味着真正的奢华必须配得上真实的优雅。

noises off.en: The coach shouted 'noises off' to ensure the team remained silent before practice began.
noises off.cn: 教练喊出‘安静’以确保球队在训练开始前保持肃静。

non sequitur.en: His sudden claim that cats rule the world is a complete non sequitur to our earlier discussion.
non sequitur.cn: 他声称猫统治世界，与我们之前的讨论毫无关联。

non-commissioned officer.en: The non-commissioned officer directed the troops with unwavering authority during the chaotic battle.
non-commissioned officer.cn: 该非委任军官在混乱的战役中以坚定的权威指挥部队。

nouveau riche.en: The nouveau riche often flaunt their sudden wealth with ostentatious displays.
nouveau riche.cn: 新贵常以炫耀性的展示来彰显其突如其来的财富。

nouvelle cuisine.en: The restaurant's nouvelle cuisine impressed critics with its innovative flavors.
nouvelle cuisine.cn: 该餐厅的新派料理以其创新风味赢得了评论家的高度赞誉。

nuclear winter.en: The nuclear winter scenario predicts a global cooling that would devastate agriculture and cause mass starvation.
nuclear winter.cn: 核冬天情景预测全球降温将摧毁农业并导致大规模饥荒。

null hypothesis.en: The null hypothesis assumes no relationship exists between the variables.
null hypothesis.cn: 零假设假定变量间不存在关系。

number crunching.en: The accountant spent hours on tedious number crunching to finalize the quarterly report.
number crunching.cn: 会计师花费数小时进行繁琐的数字计算，以完成季度报告。

nurse practitioner.en: The nurse practitioner managed the patient's complex case with exceptional skill.
nurse practitioner.cn: 该执业护士以非凡的技巧处理了患者复杂的病例。

old guard.en: The old guard resisted the new ideas, fearing they would undermine their long-standing authority.
old guard.cn: 旧派势力抵制新思想，担心这会削弱其长期以来的权威。

old hat.en: Today's hits rapidly become old hat.
old hat.cn: 今日红极一时的东西,很快就会过时。

olive branch.en: Management is holding out an olive branch to the strikers.
olive branch.cn: 资方向罢工者摆出愿意协商的姿态。

one-man band.en: He runs the business as a one-man band (= one person does everything).

one-night stand.en: I wanted it to be more than a one-night stand.
one-night stand.cn: 我要的不只是一夜情缘。

one-track mind.en: He has a one-track mind, focusing solely on his career and ignoring all other life aspects.
one-track mind.cn: 他一心只想着事业，忽略了生活的其他方面。

open house.en: It's always open house at their place.
open house.cn: 他们的房舍随时对外开放参观。

open letter.en: The journalist published an open letter criticizing the government's new policies.
open letter.cn: 该记者发表公开信，批评政府的新政策。

open mike.en: The open mic session allowed anyone to perform without prior booking.
open mike.cn: 开放麦活动允许任何人无需预先预约即可表演。

open-and-shut case.en: The murder was an open-and-shut case.
open-and-shut case.cn: 这桩谋杀案很容易侦破。

open-heart surgery.en: The patient underwent open-heart surgery to replace the faulty valve.
open-heart surgery.cn: 该患者接受开胸手术更换了故障瓣膜。

opening night.en: The opening night of the new play was a resounding success, drawing a packed house.
opening night.cn: 新剧首演大获成功，座无虚席。

operational research.en: The company relies on operational research to optimize its supply chain logistics.
operational research.cn: 该公司依靠运筹学优化其供应链物流。

order of magnitude.en: The actual measurement is two orders of magnitude (= a hundred times) greater than we expected.
order of magnitude.cn: 实际测量结果比我们预料的大两个量级(即一百倍)。

out-of-body experience.en: The out-of-body experience made her feel she was floating above the crash site.
out-of-body experience.cn: 离体体验让她感觉自己在坠毁现场上方漂浮。

packet switching.en: Packet switching replaces traditional circuit switching by breaking data into small, manageable units for efficient transmission.
packet switching.cn: 分组交换通过将数据分解为便于传输的小单元，取代了传统的电路交换。

padded cell.en: The suspect was kept in a padded cell for safety reasons.
padded cell.cn: 嫌疑人因安全原因被关入特制牢房。

paper trail.en: He was a shrewd lawyer with a talent for uncovering paper trails of fraud.
paper trail.cn: 他是个精明强干的律师,能从一连串文件的蛛丝马迹中找出诈骗。

par excellence.en: She turned out to be an organizer par excellence.
par excellence.cn: 结果表明她是一个非常出色的组织者。

paradigm shift.en: The new technology triggered a paradigm shift in how we communicate daily.
paradigm shift.cn: 这项新技术引发了我们日常沟通方式的范式转变。

parallel imports.en: Parallel imports often disrupt local pricing strategies by bringing in cheaper alternatives.
parallel imports.cn: 平行进口常通过引入更便宜的替代品扰乱当地定价策略。

parliamentary privilege.en: He made the allegation under the protection of parliamentary privilege.
parliamentary privilege.cn: 他是在议员特权的保护下说出那种毫无根据的话的。

parliamentary secretary.en: As parliamentary secretary, she handled sensitive diplomatic negotiations with great skill.
parliamentary secretary.cn: 身为议会秘书，她以高超技巧处理了敏感的外交谈判。

passive resistance.en: The workers demonstrated their passive resistance by simply refusing to operate the machinery.
passive resistance.cn: 工人们通过拒绝操作机器来实行消极抵抗。

pathetic fallacy.en: The poet attributed the storm's fury to the moon's sad expression, a classic example of pathetic fallacy.
pathetic fallacy.cn: 诗人将风暴的狂暴归咎于月亮的悲伤表情，这是拟人化谬误的典型例子。

patron saint.en: St Christopher, patron saint of travellers
patron saint.cn: 圣克利斯托弗,旅行主保

peace dividend.en: The peace dividend has allowed many nations to redirect funds from military spending to social programs.
peace dividend.cn: 和平红利使许多国家能够将资金从军费转向社会项目。

peace offering.en: The company issued a peace offering to calm the angry shareholders after the scandal.
peace offering.cn: 公司发布了一份安抚声明，以平息丑闻后愤怒股东的怒火。

peep show.en: The peep show behind the glass window offered a fascinating glimpse into their private lives.
peep show.cn: 玻璃橱窗后的表演让人窥见他们私生活的迷人一面。

pep pill.en: The doctor prescribed a pep pill to boost his energy before the marathon.
pep pill.cn: 医生给他在马拉松前开了一粒提神药以提振精力。

pep rally.en: The Democrats held a pep rally on Capitol Hill yesterday.
pep rally.cn: 民主党昨天在国会山召开了竞选誓师大会。

pep talk.en: The coach gave a pep talk to boost the team's morale before the final match.
pep talk.cn: 比赛前，教练发表鼓舞士气的讲话。

per diem.en: He agreed to pay at specified rates per diem.
per diem.cn: 他同意每天按规定的数额付款。

per se.en: The drug is not harmful per se, but is dangerous when taken with alcohol.
per se.cn: 这种药本身无害,但与酒同服就危险了。

perfect storm.en: The perfect storm of economic factors finally triggered the market crash.
perfect storm.cn: 多种经济因素形成的完美风暴最终引发了市场崩盘。

permissive society.en: Critics argue the permissive society has eroded traditional moral standards.
permissive society.cn: 批评者认为，宽容社会已侵蚀了传统道德标准。

persistent vegetative state.en: The patient remains in a persistent vegetative state despite intensive medical care.
persistent vegetative state.cn: 尽管接受积极治疗，该患者仍处于持续性植物状态。

persona non grata.en: The diplomat was declared persona non grata and ordered to leave the country immediately.
persona non grata.cn: 该外交官被宣布为不受欢迎的人，并被命令立即离境。

personal ad.en: The personal ad in the newspaper sought a lost cat with a photo.
personal ad.cn: 报纸上的个人广告配有一张照片，正在寻找一只走失的猫。

personality cult.en: The charismatic leader cultivated a personality cult that isolated his followers from critical thinking.
personality cult.cn: 这位魅力型领袖培养了一个人格崇拜，使追随者脱离批判性思维。

phantom limb.en: After amputation, she still felt phantom limb pain in the missing arm.
phantom limb.cn: 截肢后，她仍感到缺失手臂处的幻肢痛。

phoney war.en: The phoney war saw both sides preparing for the inevitable conflict without engaging in major battles.
phoney war.cn: 假战期间，双方都在为不可避免的冲突做准备，但未进行大规模战斗。

photo opportunity.en: The couple posed for a photo opportunity, unaware they were being photographed.
photo opportunity.cn: 这对夫妇摆姿势拍照，却不知自己正被拍摄。

photographic memory.en: He possesses a photographic memory, recalling every detail of his childhood instantly.
photographic memory.cn: 他拥有过目不忘的记忆力，能瞬间回忆起童年时的每一个细节。

picket line.en: Fire crews refused to cross the picket line.
picket line.cn: 消防人员拒不冲破围厂队伍人墙。

pilot light.en: The pilot light flickered, signaling that the furnace was ready to ignite.
pilot light.cn: 炉火微明，预示炉灶即将点燃。

pin money.en: She saved her pin money to buy a new designer handbag.
pin money.cn: 她攒下零花钱买了一新款设计师手袋。

pincer movement.en: The army launched a pincer movement to trap the enemy between two converging forces.
pincer movement.cn: 军队发动钳形攻势，将敌军夹在两股会合的兵力之间。

pink slip.en: She received a pink slip, indicating her immediate termination from the company.
pink slip.cn: 她收到了一张粉色辞退单，表明其已被公司立即解雇。

piping hot.en: The pizza arrived piping hot, ready to be eaten immediately.
piping hot.cn: 披萨刚出炉，热气腾腾，随时可以食用。

planned economy.en: The planned economy failed to allocate resources efficiently, leading to widespread shortages.
planned economy.cn: 计划经济未能有效配置资源，导致普遍短缺。

plate tectonics.en: Plate tectonics explains how Earth's crust moves and causes earthquakes.
plate tectonics.cn: 板块构造学说解释了地壳的运动及其引发地震的原因。

pocket veto.en: The president exercised a pocket veto by refusing to sign the bill, effectively killing it without formal action.
pocket veto.cn: 总统通过拒绝签署该法案行使了口袋否决权，实质上使其失效而未采取正式行动。

poetic justice.en: It was poetic justice that the corrupt politician met his end in a courtroom.
poetic justice.cn: 腐败政客在法庭上丧命，可谓诗意的正义。

poetic licence.en: The poet used poetic licence to alter facts for dramatic effect.
poetic licence.cn: 诗人为了戏剧效果，运用艺术虚构改变了事实。

poison pen letter.en: He wrote a poison pen letter to expose the corruption within the company.
poison pen letter.cn: 他写了一封匿名信揭露公司内部的腐败。

poison pill.en: The company issued a poison pill to stop the hostile takeover attempt.
poison pill.cn: 该公司发行了毒丸计划以阻止敌意收购企图。

political correctness.en: Critics argue that excessive political correctness stifles free debate in academic circles.
political correctness.cn: 批评者认为，过度的政治正确扼杀了学术界的自由辩论。

politically correct.en: Critics argue that being politically correct often silences honest debate in academic circles.
politically correct.cn: 批评者认为，政治正确往往使学术界的诚实辩论失声。

polyunsaturated fat.en: foods that are high in polyunsaturated fats
polyunsaturated fat.cn: 富含多不饱和脂肪的食物

pop psychology.en: Pop psychology offers quick fixes, but lacks the depth of academic research.
pop psychology.cn: 大众心理学提供速效方案，但缺乏学术研究的深度。

pop quiz.en: The teacher decided to give a pop quiz instead of the scheduled exam.
pop quiz.cn: 老师决定用突击测验代替原定的考试。

popular front.en: The popular front united diverse groups to challenge the government's unpopular policies.
popular front.cn: 统一战线团结了各种群体，以挑战政府不受欢迎的政策。

pork barrel.en: The politician secured funding for his pork barrel projects by promising tax cuts to key voters.
pork barrel.cn: 该政客向关键选民承诺减税，从而为其“小桶”项目筹措资金。

port of call.en: My first port of call in town was the bank.
port of call.cn: 我进城的第一站是银行。

position paper.en: The committee released a position paper outlining their stance on the proposed environmental regulations.
position paper.cn: 委员会发布了一份立场文件，阐述了其对拟议环境法规的态度。

positive discrimination.en: The company implemented positive discrimination to hire more women into leadership roles.
positive discrimination.cn: 该公司实施积极歧视政策，以招聘更多女性进入领导岗位。

postviral syndrome.en: Many patients experience postviral syndrome weeks after recovering from the flu.
postviral syndrome.cn: 许多患者在流感康复数周后会出现后病毒综合征。

poverty line.en: A third of the population is living at or below the poverty line.
poverty line.cn: 三分之一的人口生活在贫困线或以下。

poverty trap.en: The region remains trapped in a poverty cycle where low income prevents investment and growth.
poverty trap.cn: 该地区仍被困于贫困循环之中，低收入阻碍了投资与增长。

power broker.en: The power broker quietly orchestrated the deal that saved the company.
power broker.cn: 那位权力掮客暗中促成了拯救该公司的交易。

power dressing.en: She adopted power dressing to project authority in the boardroom.
power dressing.cn: 她在会议室采用权力着装以彰显权威。

power of attorney.en: The lawyer drafted a power of attorney to authorize her to sell the family home.
power of attorney.cn: 律师起草了一份授权书，授权她出售家庭住宅。

power play.en: The company launched a power play to dominate the emerging market.
power play.cn: 该公司发起攻势以主导新兴市场。

power politics.en: Power politics often drives international relations, where nations prioritize their own interests above all else.
power politics.cn: 权力政治常驱使国际关系，使各国将自身利益置于首位。

prayer meeting.en: The elderly gathered at the prayer meeting to seek spiritual comfort and community support.
prayer meeting.cn: 老人们聚集在祈祷会上寻求精神慰藉与社区支持。

predatory pricing.en: The company faced legal action for predatory pricing that drove competitors out of the market.
predatory pricing.cn: 该公司因掠夺性定价导致竞争对手退出市场而面临法律诉讼。

prenuptial agreement.en: They signed a prenuptial agreement to protect their assets before the wedding.
prenuptial agreement.cn: 他们在婚礼前签署婚前协议以保护资产。

presence of mind.en: The boy had the presence of mind to turn off the gas.
presence of mind.cn: 那男孩子镇定地关掉了煤气。

press secretary.en: The press secretary addressed the media regarding the government's latest policy announcement.
press secretary.cn: 新闻秘书就政府最新政策声明向媒体发表讲话。

price controls.en: The government imposed strict price controls to stabilize the market during the crisis.
price controls.cn: 政府实施严格的价格管制以稳定危机期间的市场。

prima facie.en: Prima facie, there is a strong case against him.
prima facie.cn: 据初步认定,证据对他极其不利。

primary source.en: We must rely on primary sources to verify the historical accuracy of our findings.
primary source.cn: 我们必须依靠原始资料来核实研究结论的历史准确性。

prisoner of conscience.en: He remains a prisoner of conscience, refusing to compromise his beliefs under any circumstances.
prisoner of conscience.cn: 他坚守良知，在任何情况下都不愿妥协自己的信念。

private member's bill.en: The private member's bill aims to reform the healthcare system but lacks sufficient funding.
private member's bill.cn: 该私人议员法案旨在改革医疗体系，但缺乏充足资金。

pro forma.en: a pro forma invoice (= a document that gives details of the goods being sent to a customer)

pro rata.en: If costs go up, there will be a pro rata increase in prices.
pro rata.cn: 如果成本增加,价格就会相应上涨。

procurator fiscal.en: The procurator fiscal must decide whether to prosecute the suspect.
procurator fiscal.cn: 检察官必须决定是否起诉嫌疑人。

product placement.en: The movie featured prominent product placement for luxury cars throughout its runtime.
product placement.cn: 该片在整部影片中显著地植入豪华汽车广告。

professional foul.en: The referee called a professional foul after the striker deliberately tripped the opponent to stop the play.
professional foul.cn: 裁判判罚了职业犯规，因为前锋故意绊倒对手以阻止比赛进行。

profit and loss account.en: The company's profit and loss account reveals a significant decline in quarterly earnings.
profit and loss account.cn: 公司损益表显示季度盈利显著下降。

programmed learning.en: Programmed learning transforms complex subjects into self-paced, bite-sized modules that students can master independently.
programmed learning.cn: 程序化学习将复杂学科转化为学生可独立掌握的、节奏自定的短小模块。

promissory note.en: The company issued a promissory note to secure the loan from investors.
promissory note.cn: 该公司发行本票以担保从投资者处获得的贷款。

proportional representation.en: The new electoral system uses proportional representation to ensure minority voices are heard in parliament.
proportional representation.cn: 新选举制度采用比例代表制，以确保少数派声音在议会中得到体现。

prose poem.en: The prose poem blends narrative flow with poetic imagery to evoke deep emotional resonance.
prose poem.cn: 散文诗将叙事流与诗意意象融合，以唤起深刻的情感共鸣。

proving ground.en: It's an ideal proving ground for the new car.
proving ground.cn: 这里是个理想的新车试验场。

psychological warfare.en: The spy agency launched a psychological warfare campaign to undermine the enemy's morale.
psychological warfare.cn: 该间谍机构发动了一场心理战行动，以削弱敌军士气。

public defender.en: The public defender argued that the evidence was insufficient to prove his innocence.
public defender.cn: 公共辩护人辩称证据不足以证明其无罪。

public nuisance.en: He was charged with committing (a) public nuisance.

public prosecutor.en: The public prosecutor presented compelling evidence against the defendant in court.
public prosecutor.cn: 公诉人在法庭上提出了确凿的证据指控被告。

puppy fat.en: The puppy fat from the winter sun made his cheeks look round and happy.
puppy fat.cn: 冬日暖阳让小狗的脸颊显得圆润可爱。

puppy love.en: Their puppy love quickly faded when reality set in.
puppy love.cn: 当现实袭来时，他们的少年情愫便迅速消逝了。

purse strings.en: Who holds the purse strings in your house?

quality assurance.en: The company implemented rigorous quality assurance protocols to guarantee product excellence.
quality assurance.cn: 该公司实施了严格的质控程序以确保产品卓越。

quid pro quo.en: The politician offered a tax cut as quid pro quo for the new infrastructure bill.
quid pro quo.cn: 该政客以减税作为通过新基建法案的交换条件。

racial profiling.en: Critics argue that racial profiling undermines civil rights and fuels social division.
racial profiling.cn: 批评者认为，种族画像侵蚀了公民权利并加剧了社会分裂。

rack rate.en: The hotel charged the rack rate, which was significantly higher than their usual discounted pricing.
rack rate.cn: 该酒店按挂牌价收费，远高于其常规折扣价。

radical chic.en: The restaurant's radical chic decor alienated regular customers who preferred traditional comfort.
radical chic.cn: 餐厅前卫的装饰令偏爱传统舒适感的常客感到疏离。

rain check.en: 'Are you coming for a drink?' 'Can I take a rain check?—I must get this finished tonight.'
rain check.cn: "你来喝一杯吧？" "下次吧,好吗？今晚我得把这项工作做完。"

rallying cry.en: The protesters issued a rallying cry for immediate justice and an end to the corruption.
rallying cry.cn: 抗议者呼吁立即伸张正义并结束腐败。

rat race.en: The rat race of corporate life often leaves people feeling exhausted and unfulfilled.
rat race.cn: 职场中的竞争往往让人感到疲惫不堪且缺乏成就感。

rat run.en: The bank launched a rat run, withdrawing all deposits as customers panicked.
rat run.cn: 银行启动挤兑，在客户恐慌中提走全部存款。

reality check.en: Let's do a reality check on our current financial situation before making any major decisions.
reality check.cn: 在做出任何重大决定前，我们先对目前的财务状况进行一次现实核查。

rearguard action.en: They have been fighting a rearguard action for two years to stop their house being demolished.
rearguard action.cn: 两年来,为了不让拆除他们的房子,他们一直在进行最后的努力。

record holder.en: She remains the record holder for the most goals scored in a single season.
record holder.cn: 她仍是单赛季进球数最多的纪录保持者。

red alert.en: Following the bomb blast, local hospitals have been put on red alert.
red alert.cn: 炸弹爆炸之后,当地医院一直处于戒备状态。

red flag.en: The job offer was a red flag, suggesting hidden dangers ahead.
red flag.cn: 这份工作邀约是个红色警报，预示着前方暗藏危险。

red herring.en: The detective realized the red herring was a deliberate distraction from the real clue.
red herring.cn: 侦探意识到红鲱鱼是对真实线索的故意误导。

red tape.en: The project stalled because of excessive red tape from the bureaucracy.
red tape.cn: 该项目因官僚机构繁文缛节过多而停滞不前。

red-letter day.en: She saved her biggest project for a red-letter day when the board finally approved it.
red-letter day.cn: 她终于等到董事会批准的那天——一个红日子，才着手推进那个最大的项目。

red-light district.en: The city's red-light district attracts many tourists seeking entertainment.
red-light district.cn: 该市红灯区吸引了许多寻求娱乐的游客。

reductio ad absurdum.en: His reductio ad absurdum proved the theory wrong by showing its logical contradictions.
reductio ad absurdum.cn: 他通过揭示其逻辑矛盾，以归谬法证明了该理论是错误的。

reference point.en: We used the old building as a reference point for measuring the new city's growth.
reference point.cn: 我们将旧楼作为参照点，以衡量这座新城市的增长。

relational database.en: The relational database efficiently organizes data through structured tables and relationships.
relational database.cn: 关系型数据库通过结构化的表和关联高效地组织数据。

restraining order.en: The restraining order prevented him from contacting her under any circumstances.
restraining order.cn: 该禁令禁止他在任何情况下与她联系。

retail therapy.en: I was ready for a little retail therapy.
retail therapy.cn: 我准备去接受一下购物治疗。

reverse engineering.en: The company was accused of reverse engineering their competitor's patented software.
reverse engineering.cn: 该公司被指控反向工程竞争对手的专利软件。

revolving door.en: The company became a revolving-door workplace.
revolving door.cn: 这家公司成了工作的中转站。

rheumatic fever.en: The patient suffered from rheumatic fever after an untreated streptococcal infection.
rheumatic fever.cn: 该患者在未经治疗的链球菌感染后患上了风湿热。

rhyming slang.en: The waiter's rhyming slang order confused the customer until she realized it meant coffee.
rhyming slang.cn: 侍者用押韵俚语点的咖啡让顾客困惑不已，直到她意识到那是咖啡。

rhythm guitar.en: The drummer kept the beat while her rhythm guitar added subtle texture.
rhythm guitar.cn: 鼓手维持着节拍，她的节奏吉他增添了细微的质感。

right of abode.en: Citizens retain the right of abode to live and work in their own country without restriction.
right of abode.cn: 公民享有在其本国无限制居住和工作的权利。

right-hand man.en: He is the right-hand man to the CEO, always handling his most critical tasks.
right-hand man.cn: 他是首席执行官的得力助手，总是负责处理最关键的任务。

rights issue.en: The company raised capital by issuing new shares to existing shareholders in a rights issue.
rights issue.cn: 该公司通过向现有股东发行新股进行增资。

ripple effect.en: His resignation will have a ripple effect on the whole department.
ripple effect.cn: 他的辞职将会在整个部门中引起连锁反应。

rite of passage.en: Graduating from university is a significant rite of passage marking the transition to adulthood.
rite of passage.cn: 大学毕业是标志成年过渡的重要人生仪式。

road rage.en: The driver's aggressive road rage led to a serious collision on the highway.
road rage.cn: 驾驶员的鲁莽驾驶导致高速公路上发生严重碰撞。

roaring twenties.en: The roaring twenties were a time of exuberant optimism and reckless spending among young people.
roaring twenties.cn: 咆哮的二十年代是年轻人充满乐观与挥霍的时代。

rock solid.en: The support for the party was rock solid.
rock solid.cn: 这一政党得到了坚定的支持。

rough and tumble.en: the rough and tumble of politics

rough cut.en: The rough cut of the film still needs significant editing to improve the narrative flow.
rough cut.cn: 该片粗剪版仍需大幅剪辑以优化叙事节奏。

royal assent.en: The monarch granted his royal assent to the new legislation after weeks of debate.
royal assent.cn: 君主在数周的辩论后，正式批准了这项新立法。

rubber bullet.en: The police used rubber bullets to disperse the violent crowd without causing serious injury.
rubber bullet.cn: 警方使用橡胶子弹驱散暴乱人群，未造成严重伤害。

rubber stamp.en: Parliament is seen as a rubber stamp for decisions made elsewhere.
rubber stamp.cn: 议会被看作橡皮图章,只会批准他人的决定。

ruby wedding.en: They celebrated their ruby wedding anniversary with a surprise trip to Italy.
ruby wedding.cn: 他们以一次意大利之旅庆祝了红宝石婚寿。

running commentary.en: to give a running commentary on the game

running mate.en: The presidential nominee was advised to choose a woman as a running mate.
running mate.cn: 有人建议总统候选人找一位女性竞选伙伴。

safe haven.en: The stock market served as a safe haven for investors fleeing volatile conditions.
safe haven.cn: 股市成为投资者逃离动荡环境的避风港。

safe house.en: The spies met in a safe house to discuss their next covert operation.
safe house.cn: 特工们在安全屋会面，商讨下一次秘密行动。

safety net.en: people who have fallen through the safety net and ended up homeless on the streets
safety net.cn: 未能享受保障措施终致流落街头的人

safety valve.en: Exercise is a good safety valve for the tension that builds up at work.
safety valve.cn: 锻炼身体是排解工作压力的好办法。

sales talk.en: The salesman's relentless sales talk failed to convince the skeptical customer of the product's value.
sales talk.cn: 推销员滔滔不绝的劝说未能说服这位持怀疑态度的顾客认可该产品的价值。

sampling error.en: The survey's conclusions might be flawed due to a significant sampling error.
sampling error.cn: 该调查结论可能因抽样误差过大而存在缺陷。

saturated fat.en: Consuming too much saturated fat can lead to serious heart problems.
saturated fat.cn: 摄入过多饱和脂肪可能导致严重的心脏问题。

school run.en: The school run was chaotic as parents rushed to pick up their children from the gates.
school run.cn: 学校放学时场面混乱，家长们争相从校门口接孩子。

scorched earth policy.en: The scorched earth policy left the countryside barren, with no crops or water remaining for future generations.
scorched earth policy.cn: 焦土政策使乡村变得荒芜，未来世代再无作物和水源。

screen dump.en: The hacker used a screen dump to capture the entire monitor's display instantly.
screen dump.cn: 黑客利用屏幕截图功能瞬间捕获了整个显示器画面。

scrum half.en: The scrum half must make a quick decision to distribute the ball effectively.
scrum half.cn: 前锋必须迅速做出有效分球决策。

sea change.en: The company underwent a sea change after adopting sustainable practices.
sea change.cn: 该公司在采用可持续做法后发生了根本性转变。

search warrant.en: Police obtained a search warrant to enter the suspect's home and seize evidence.
search warrant.cn: 警方获得搜查令进入嫌疑人住所并扣押证据。

second in command.en: As the second in command, she coordinated the rescue efforts with precision.
second in command.cn: 作为副手，她精准地协调了救援工作。

second language acquisition.en: Second language acquisition often involves complex cognitive processes that differ from first language learning.
second language acquisition.cn: 第二语言习得常涉及与第一语言学习不同的复杂认知过程。

second nature.en: After years of practice, driving became second nature for her.
second nature.cn: 经过多年练习，开车对她来说已成本能。

second wind.en: She finally found a second wind after resting for an hour.
second wind.cn: 休息一小时后，她终于重新振作起来。

secondary source.en: The researcher relied on secondary sources to verify the primary data collected.
secondary source.cn: 该研究人员利用二手资料对收集的一手数据进行核实。

semantic field.en: The semantic field of 'family' terms reveals how cultural values shape our vocabulary.
semantic field.cn: ‘家庭’一词的语义场揭示了文化价值观如何塑造我们的词汇。

sentence adverb.en: In 'Luckily, I didn't tell anyone' and 'Financially, we have a serious problem', 'luckily' and 'financially' are sentence adverbs.
sentence adverb.cn: 在句子 Luckily, I didn't tell anyone 和 Financially, we have a serious problem 中,luckily 和 financially 是句副词。

separation of powers.en: The separation of powers ensures that no single branch of government holds absolute authority.
separation of powers.cn: 权力分立确保没有任何一个政府部门拥有绝对权威。

sequence of tenses.en: The sequence of tenses ensures that the verb forms in subordinate clauses correctly reflect their relationship to the main clause.
sequence of tenses.cn: 时态序列确保从句中的动词形式能正确反映其与主句的关系。

sex chromosome.en: The sex chromosome determines biological gender in humans.
sex chromosome.cn: 性染色体决定人类的性别。

sexual harassment.en: The company must take immediate action against sexual harassment to maintain a safe workplace environment.
sexual harassment.cn: 公司必须立即采取行动制止性骚扰，以维护安全的工作环境。

sheriff court.en: The defendant was held in the sheriff's court awaiting trial.
sheriff court.cn: 被告被关押在治安法院等待审判。

shock jock.en: The shock jock's outrageous jokes often alienated his regular listeners.
shock jock.cn: 这位脱口秀主持人的荒诞笑话常常疏远了他的常规听众。

shock tactics.en: The politician used shock tactics to gain attention, but the media quickly lost interest.
shock tactics.cn: 该政客利用震惊战术博取关注，但媒体很快便失去了兴趣。

shock therapy.en: The government implemented shock therapy to rapidly stabilize the economy after the collapse.
shock therapy.cn: 政府在经济崩溃后实施休克疗法以迅速稳定经济。

shock troops.en: The shock troops stormed the enemy lines, causing immediate panic among the defenders.
shock troops.cn: 突击部队猛攻敌军防线，致使守军顿时惊慌失措。

shop steward.en: The shop steward organized a meeting to discuss the workers' recent grievances.
shop steward.cn: 工会代表召集会议，讨论工人们近期的不满。

shop talk.en: The employees engaged in shop talk about the upcoming product launch during their break.
shop talk.cn: 员工们在休息时闲聊即将推出的新产品。

short circuit.en: The sudden short circuit caused the entire building's electrical system to fail instantly.
short circuit.cn: 突然的短路导致整栋建筑的电力系统瞬间瘫痪。

shutter speed.en: A slow shutter speed allows more light in, creating a blurred effect of moving subjects.
shutter speed.cn: 慢快门速度允许更多光线进入，使移动主体产生模糊效果。

shuttle diplomacy.en: The UN envoy practiced shuttle diplomacy by visiting both sides separately to negotiate peace.
shuttle diplomacy.cn: 联合国特使通过分别会见双方进行穿梭外交以谋求和平。

sick building syndrome.en: The office's sick building syndrome caused many employees to feel exhausted and dizzy.
sick building syndrome.cn: 该办公室的“病态建筑综合征”导致多名员工感到疲惫和眩晕。

signal-to-noise ratio.en: The signal-to-noise ratio determines how clearly the message stands out from background interference.
signal-to-noise ratio.cn: 信噪比决定了消息从背景干扰中凸显的清晰度。

silent majority.en: The silent majority often drives policy changes without ever speaking up in public.
silent majority.cn: 沉默的大多数往往在公开场合从不发声的情况下推动政策变革。

silly season.en: The silly season is when people make foolish choices about their relationships.
silly season.cn: 愚蠢季节是人们在感情中做出糊涂决定的时期。

silver tongue.en: Her silver tongue convinced the skeptical investors to fund her startup immediately.
silver tongue.cn: 她凭借出色的口才说服了持怀疑态度的投资者立即资助她的初创企业。

sine qua non.en: This rigorous training is the sine qua non of becoming a top surgeon.
sine qua non.cn: 这种严格的训练是成为顶尖外科医生的必要条件。

single market.en: The single market allows goods and services to flow freely across borders without tariffs.
single market.cn: 单一市场允许商品和服务在免关税的情况下自由跨境流通。

single transferable vote.en: The single transferable vote system allows voters to rank candidates, ensuring proportional representation in the legislature.
single transferable vote.cn: 单一可转让票制允许选民对候选人进行排序，确保立法机构实现比例代表制。

sitting duck.en: The new startup is now a sitting duck for aggressive market competition.
sitting duck.cn: 这家新创业公司如今已沦为激烈市场竞争中的待宰羔羊。

skeleton key.en: The security guard refused the skeleton key, insisting on proper identification for entry.
skeleton key.cn: 保安拒绝使用万能钥匙，坚持要求出示证件方可进入。

slam dunk.en: Politically, this issue is a slam dunk for the party.
slam dunk.cn: 在政治上,这一课题是这个党的一张胜券。

sleight of hand.en: The trick is done simply by sleight of hand.
sleight of hand.cn: 变这个戏法全凭手法敏捷。

sliding scale.en: Fees are calculated on a sliding scale according to income (= richer people pay more).
sliding scale.cn: 按浮动费率制根据收入高低计算收费。

slush fund.en: The scandal exposed how the politician secretly used a slush fund to bribe officials.
slush fund.cn: 该丑闻揭露了政客秘密利用“黑金”基金贿赂官员的行径。

small beer.en: That minor issue is just a small beer compared to the crisis we face.
small beer.cn: 与当前面临的危机相比，这个小问题简直微不足道。

small claims court.en: The small claims court ruled that the contractor must repair the leaking roof within two weeks.
small claims court.cn: 小额索赔法院裁定承包商须于两周内修复漏水屋顶。

small print.en: Read all the small print before signing.
small print.cn: 把小号字印刷的附加条款全部看过以后再签字。

small talk.en: We spent the flight chatting about trivial things like weather and movies, which is classic small talk.
small talk.cn: 我们整趟飞行都在聊天气和电影等琐事，这是典型的寒暄。

smart money.en: It seems the smart money is no longer in insurance (= is no longer being invested in insurance companies).
smart money.cn: 似乎专业投资不再投向保险业。

smoke bomb.en: The smoke bomb filled the room, making it impossible for anyone to see or breathe.
smoke bomb.cn: 烟雾弹充满了房间，让人无法看见或呼吸。

smoking gun.en: This memo could be the smoking gun that investigators have been looking for.
smoking gun.cn: 这份备忘录可能是调查人员一直在寻找的证据。

sneak preview.en: Before the official launch, we offered a sneak preview of our new product to select investors.
sneak preview.cn: 在正式发布前，我们向精选投资者展示了新产品预览。

snooze button.en: She hit the snooze button again, hoping to catch a few more minutes of sleep.
snooze button.cn: 她再次按下闹钟暂停键，希望能再多睡一会儿。

snow job.en: The salesman gave us a complete snow job, promising features that never existed.
snow job.cn: 推销员对我们进行了彻底的欺骗，承诺了那些根本不存在的功能。

social contract.en: The social contract implies that citizens surrender some freedoms in exchange for security and order.
social contract.cn: 社会契约意味着公民让渡部分自由以换取安全与秩序。

social engineering.en: The hacker used social engineering to trick the employee into revealing sensitive data.
social engineering.cn: 黑客利用社会工程学诱骗员工泄露敏感数据。

socialist realism.en: The regime mandated socialist realism as the sole acceptable artistic style for all public works.
socialist realism.cn: 该政权规定社会主义现实主义为所有公共艺术作品唯一可接受的艺术风格。

socialized medicine.en: Socialized medicine remains a contentious topic in many Western nations today.
socialized medicine.cn: 社会化医疗如今仍是许多西方国家争论不休的话题。

soft sell.en: The company chose a soft sell approach to introduce the new product without alarming customers.
soft sell.cn: 该公司采用软性推销的方式推出新产品，以免引起顾客担忧。

sold out.en: The concert tickets sold out instantly, leaving fans disappointed.
sold out.cn: 音乐会门票瞬间售罄，令歌迷失望。

solitary confinement.en: The prisoner spent three years in solitary confinement, which severely damaged his mental health.
solitary confinement.cn: 该囚犯被单独关押三年，严重损害了其心理健康。

solvent abuse.en: The patient's rapid weight loss suggests possible solvent abuse rather than simple starvation.
solvent abuse.cn: 患者体重迅速下降提示可能为溶剂滥用而非单纯饥饿所致。

sought after.en: This design is the most sought after.

sound barrier.en: to break the sound barrier (= to travel faster than the speed of sound)
sound barrier.cn: 突破音障(即超过音速运行)

sound bite.en: The politician's entire speech was reduced to a single, misleading sound bite.
sound bite.cn: 这位政治家的整篇演讲被简化为一个具有误导性的简短片段。

sounding board.en: We need a sounding board to test our new marketing strategy before launching it.
sounding board.cn: 我们需要一个试金石，在推出新营销策略前检验其可行性。

spaced out.en: He was so spaced out that he missed the entire lecture without realizing it.
spaced out.cn: 他走神太厉害，竟没意识到自己错过了整场讲座。

spaghetti western.en: The spaghetti western genre features exaggerated violence and stereotypical characters.
spaghetti western.cn: 西部牛仔片类型以夸张暴力和刻板角色为特征。

spare tyre.en: The spare tyre on the car is missing, so we can't go anywhere.
spare tyre.cn: 汽车备胎缺失，因此无法出行。

sparring partner.en: She serves as a sparring partner, helping me refine my debating skills before major competitions.
sparring partner.cn: 她担任我的陪练，帮助我在重要比赛前打磨辩论技巧。

special interest group.en: The special interest group successfully lobbied for the new environmental regulations.
special interest group.cn: 该特别利益集团成功游说通过了新的环境法规。

special pleading.en: His special pleading for an exception was rejected by the committee.
special pleading.cn: 委员会驳回了其要求例外的特殊请求。

speech act.en: The politician's speech was a performative act that legally bound the nation to new treaties.
speech act.cn: 该政治家的演讲是一项具有法律约束力的行为，使国家受新条约的约束。

spin doctor.en: The spin doctor carefully crafted the narrative to protect the politician's reputation.
spin doctor.cn: 该公关专家精心策划了叙事，以保护政治家的声誉。

split second.en: Their eyes met for a split second.
split second.cn: 在一刹那间,他们的目光交汇在了一起。

spoils system.en: The spoils system allowed political allies to secure government jobs in exchange for their loyalty.
spoils system.cn: 该制度允许政治盟友以效忠换取政府职位。

spot check.en: to carry out random spot checks on vehicles

spot on.en: His assessment of the situation was spot on.
spot on.cn: 他对形势的判断完全准确。

spread betting.en: He made a fortune through spread betting on the stock market's volatile fluctuations.
spread betting.cn: 他通过赌注交易股市的波动获利丰厚。

squeaky clean.en: The company's financial records were squeaky clean, with zero violations found during the audit.
squeaky clean.cn: 该公司财务记录一尘不染，审计未发现任何违规。

stage fright.en: She overcame her stage fright by practicing repeatedly before the audience.
stage fright.cn: 她通过在观众面前反复练习克服了上台前的紧张。

standard deduction.en: The family claimed a substantial standard deduction to significantly lower their taxable income.
standard deduction.cn: 该家庭申报了大额标准扣除额，从而大幅降低了应纳税所得额。

star turn.en: Her unexpected star turn in the play surprised everyone with her incredible talent.
star turn.cn: 她在剧中出乎意料的精彩表现令众人惊叹于其非凡才华。

state of the art.en: The system was state of the art.
state of the art.cn: 这一系统是当时最先进的。

state's attorney.en: The state's attorney argued that the evidence proved the defendant's guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
state's attorney.cn: 检察官辩称，证据已证明被告有罪，且无可置疑。

state's evidence.en: The prosecution presented state's evidence to prove the defendant's guilt in court.
state's evidence.cn: 检方在法庭上出示证据，证明被告有罪。

status quo.en: to defend / restore the status quo
status quo.cn: 维持现状；恢复原来的状况

statute book.en: It's not yet on the statute book (= it has not yet become law).
statute book.cn: 这项内容还未成为正式法规。

statute of limitations.en: The statute of limitations expired before the police could file charges against him.
statute of limitations.cn: 在他被起诉前，追诉期已过。

statutory holiday.en: The statutory holiday this year falls on a Sunday, so we will work extra hours to compensate.
statutory holiday.cn: 今年法定假日恰逢周日，我们将加班补休。

statutory instrument.en: The new regulations were introduced via a statutory instrument last month.
statutory instrument.cn: 新法规已于上月通过法定令颁布。

statutory offence.en: The new law classifies this behavior as a statutory offence, carrying severe penalties.
statutory offence.cn: 新法将此类行为定性为法定犯罪，并规定严厉处罚。

staying power.en: The new policy has impressive staying power, as it continues to influence public opinion months later.
staying power.cn: 这项新政策影响力持久，数月后仍持续影响舆论。

steering committee.en: The steering committee will guide the project's direction until completion.
steering committee.cn: 指导委员会将引领项目方向直至完成。

stepping stone.en: a stepping stone to a more lucrative career
stepping stone.cn: 涉足更赚钱的行业的敲门砖

sticker price.en: The sticker price of the car is $30,000, but it will likely be discounted significantly.
sticker price.cn: 该车标价 3 万美元，但很可能会有大幅折扣。

sticker shock.en: The sticker shock of upgrading my car was immediate, but the new safety features were worth it.
sticker shock.cn: 换车时的价格冲击立竿见影，但新安全配置物有所值。

sticking point.en: This was six of the major sticking points in the negotiations.
sticking point.cn: 这是谈判中主要的难点之一。

stink bomb.en: The stink bomb filled the room with a foul odor that made everyone cough.
stink bomb.cn: 催泪瓦斯使房间里充满了令人作呕的气味，让人纷纷咳嗽。

stool pigeon.en: The witness, known as a stool pigeon, betrayed his own gang to the police.
stool pigeon.cn: 该证人作为线人向警方出卖了自己的帮派。

stop press.en: The stop press report confirmed the government's sudden decision to halt all new funding.
stop press.cn: 最后一刻的报道证实了政府突然决定停止所有新拨款。

straight man.en: In the comedy duo, he played the straight man while his partner delivered the jokes.
straight man.cn: 在这对喜剧搭档中，他扮演直男角色，由搭档负责讲笑话。

straight ticket.en: The candidate secured a straight ticket victory by winning both the primary and general elections.
straight ticket.cn: 该候选人通过赢得初选和大选，实现了连任。

straw poll.en: The straw poll suggested a narrow victory for the incumbent candidate.
straw poll.cn: 民意测验显示现任候选人将赢得微弱胜利。

stream of consciousness.en: The novel captures the stream of consciousness, revealing raw thoughts as they flow through the protagonist's mind.
stream of consciousness.cn: 这部小说捕捉了意识流，揭示了主人公脑海中思绪的原始流动。

street cred.en: Those clothes do nothing for your street cred.
street cred.cn: 穿这几件衣服你就成老土了。

strip mining.en: Strip mining involves removing the topsoil to access coal deposits deep underground.
strip mining.cn: 露天开采涉及移除表层土壤以获取地下的煤炭矿藏。

structural linguistics.en: Structural linguistics analyzes language by examining how individual elements combine to form larger units.
structural linguistics.cn: 结构语言学通过分析单个要素如何组合成更大的单位来研究语言。

stumbling block.en: His lack of confidence remains a stumbling block to his career advancement.
stumbling block.cn: 他缺乏自信，阻碍了他的职业发展。

sub judice.en: The case remains sub judice, so no one should comment on the verdict until it is officially announced.
sub judice.cn: 该案尚在审理中，故在判决正式公布前，任何人不得发表评论。

subordinate clause.en: The subordinate clause explains the main idea in more detail.
subordinate clause.cn: 从属句对主要观点进行了更详细的解释。

subordinating conjunction.en: She used subordinating conjunctions to connect her complex ideas smoothly.
subordinating conjunction.cn: 她运用从属连词将复杂的思想流畅地连接起来。

succession planning.en: Effective succession planning ensures organizational stability when key leaders retire or leave unexpectedly.
succession planning.cn: 有效的继任计划能确保在关键领导者退休或意外离职时组织保持稳定。

sugar daddy.en: The young actress relied on her sugar daddy for financial support throughout her early career.
sugar daddy.cn: 这位年轻女演员在早期职业生涯中一直依靠她的“金主”提供经济支持。

sui generis.en: The case is sui generis, requiring a unique legal approach rather than applying existing precedents.
sui generis.cn: 该案具有独特性，需采取专门的法律方法，而非适用既有判例。

summa cum laude.en: He graduated summa cum laude from Harvard.
summa cum laude.cn: 他以最优等成绩从哈佛大学毕业。

surrogate mother.en: The couple hired a surrogate mother to carry their genetically related baby.
surrogate mother.cn: 这对夫妇雇佣了一位代孕母亲来孕育他们基因相关的孩子。

survival kit.en: The survival kit included a first-aid set, a compass, and extra water.
survival kit.cn: 求生包内含急救箱、指南针和额外饮用水。

suspended animation.en: The hibernating bear entered a state of suspended animation to survive the harsh winter months.
suspended animation.cn: 冬眠的熊进入假死状态以度过严酷的寒冬。

suspended sentence.en: The court granted him a suspended sentence, allowing him to remain free while completing community service.
suspended sentence.cn: 法院判处他缓刑，允许他在完成社区服务期间保持自由。

sweet spot.en: We finally found the sweet spot where our sales doubled overnight.
sweet spot.cn: 我们终于找到了让销售额一夜翻倍的黄金点。

tactical voting.en: Voters cast tactical ballots to support a preferred candidate over their own party's choice.
tactical voting.cn: 选民投出策略性选票，以支持自己更偏好的候选人，而非本党提名的候选人。

take-home pay.en: After deducting taxes, her take-home pay is higher than expected this month.
take-home pay.cn: 扣除税款后，她这个月的实得工资高于预期。

tax avoidance.en: The company utilized tax avoidance strategies to legally minimize its corporate tax obligations.
tax avoidance.cn: 该公司利用避税策略合法降低其企业所得税负担。

tax bracket.en: There are now only ten tax brackets—22% and 40%.
tax bracket.cn: 现在纳税收入只有两个纳税档次:22% 和 40%。

tax break.en: The government offered a tax break to encourage small businesses to expand.
tax break.cn: 政府提供税收减免以鼓励小企业扩大规模。

tax evasion.en: The company faced severe penalties for its systematic tax evasion scheme.
tax evasion.cn: 该公司因系统性的逃税计划而面临严厉处罚。

tax exile.en: Many wealthy individuals choose tax exile to avoid high income taxes in their home country.
tax exile.cn: 许多富裕人士选择避税以规避本国的高额所得税。

tax haven.en: Many corporations prefer to register in tax havens to minimize their global tax obligations.
tax haven.cn: 许多公司倾向于在避税地注册，以减少全球税务负担。

tax shelter.en: The company utilized a tax shelter to legally minimize its corporate income tax liability.
tax shelter.cn: 该公司利用避税手段合法减少了企业所得税负担。

tear jerker.en: The movie was a real tear jerker, leaving the audience in emotional turmoil.
tear jerker.cn: 这部电影极具煽情，令观众情绪激动。

technical foul.en: The referee called a technical foul when the player used excessive force during the match.
technical foul.cn: 比赛期间，该球员使用过度力量时，裁判判其技术犯规。

technical knockout.en: The boxer secured a technical knockout by forcing the referee to stop the match due to severe injury.
technical knockout.cn: 该拳击手因迫使裁判因严重受伤停止比赛而获得技术性击倒获胜。

teething troubles.en: The new software had some teething troubles before it became fully reliable.
teething troubles.cn: 该软件在完全可靠之前曾遇到一些磨合问题。

telephone tapping.en: The government's telephone tapping revealed the corrupt officials' secret meetings.
telephone tapping.cn: 政府窃听电话揭露了腐败官员的秘密会议。

terms of reference.en: The matter, they decided, lay outside the commission's terms of reference.
terms of reference.cn: 他们认定这个问题不在委员会受托权限之内。

territorial waters.en: The ship was forced to turn back after entering the country's territorial waters.
territorial waters.cn: 该船在驶入该国领水后被迫返航。

test bed.en: The new software will undergo rigorous testing in this dedicated test bed before deployment.
test bed.cn: 该软件将在专用测试环境中进行严格测试后部署。

test case.en: The test case revealed a critical bug that crashed the entire application.
test case.cn: 该测试用例揭示了一个导致整个应用程序崩溃的关键缺陷。

testing ground.en: a piece of land in use as a tank testing ground
testing ground.cn: 用作坦克试验场的一块土地

thematic role.en: The thematic role of the subject is often interpreted as the agent in active sentences.
thematic role.cn: 在主动句中，主语的主题角色常被解释为施事者。

think tank.en: The think tank produced a comprehensive report on global climate change.
think tank.cn: 该智库发布了一份关于全球气候变化的综合报告。

thought police.en: The government's thought police monitor citizens' private conversations to suppress dissent.
thought police.cn: 政府的思想警察监控公民的私人对话以压制异议。

time signature.en: The piece alternates between 4/4 and 3/4 time signatures to create rhythmic tension.
time signature.cn: 该乐曲在 4/4 拍与 3/4 拍之间交替，以营造节奏张力。

time-and-motion study.en: The factory implemented a time-and-motion study to optimize assembly line efficiency.
time-and-motion study.cn: 工厂实施了时间动作研究以优化装配线效率。

tipping point.en: The pandemic reached a tipping point when social distancing failed to slow the virus's spread.
tipping point.cn: 疫情在社交距离措施无法遏制病毒传播时达到临界点。

tit for tat.en: the routine tit for tat when countries expel each other's envoys
tit for tat.cn: 国家相互驱逐对方使节这种惯常的报复行动

top brass.en: All the top brass was / were at the ceremony.
top brass.cn: 所有要员都出席了典礼。

tough love.en: Parents sometimes practice tough love by forcing their children to face reality.
tough love.cn: 父母有时通过强迫孩子直面现实来实行严慈相济的爱。

tour de force.en: The playwright's latest work remains a tour de force, showcasing unparalleled mastery of character development.
tour de force.cn: 这部剧作仍是登峰造极之作，展现了无与伦比的人物塑造能力。

tourist trap.en: Many locals avoid this tourist trap because the prices are exorbitant and the quality is poor.
tourist trap.cn: 许多当地人避而远之，因为价格过高且质量低劣。

tout court.en: It was a lie, tout court.

track record.en: He has a proven track record in marketing.
track record.cn: 他有可靠的销售业绩记录。

trade deficit.en: The country's trade deficit widened due to rising oil prices and falling exports.
trade deficit.cn: 该国贸易赤字因油价上涨和出口下降而扩大。

trade secret.en: The recipe for their drink is a closely guarded trade secret.
trade secret.cn: 他们饮料的配方是严格保守的商业秘密。

trading floor.en: The traders rushed to the trading floor as the market crashed.
trading floor.cn: 市场崩盘时，交易员们冲向交易大厅。

traffic calming.en: The council installed speed bumps to implement traffic calming measures in the busy residential area.
traffic calming.cn: 该委员会在繁忙的居民区安装了减速带，以实施交通缓行措施。

tragic irony.en: The tragedy of his failure was the ironic twist that he had only just learned to swim.
tragic irony.cn: 他失败的悲剧在于，他刚刚学会游泳。

transformational grammar.en: Chomsky's transformational grammar revolutionized our understanding of how human language is structured.
transformational grammar.cn: 乔姆斯基的转换生成语法革新了我们对人类语言结构的理解。

transition metal.en: Transition metals like iron and copper are essential for biological processes.
transition metal.cn: 铁和铜等过渡金属对生物过程至关重要。

trash talk.en: The coach's trash talk only fueled the team's competitive fire.
trash talk.cn: 教练的挑衅反而点燃了球队的斗志。

trial balloon.en: The government released a trial balloon to gauge public reaction before making an official policy decision.
trial balloon.cn: 政府在正式制定政策前，先放出试探性消息以观察公众反应。

trophic level.en: The third trophic level in this aquatic ecosystem consists primarily of small fish and plankton.
trophic level.cn: 该水生生态系统的第三营养级主要由小鱼和浮游生物组成。

trophy wife.en: Critics often label her a trophy wife, despite her own successful career in business.
trophy wife.cn: 尽管她拥有成功的商业生涯，批评者仍常将她称为花瓶妻子。

trump card.en: She played her trump card by revealing the secret investment plan to investors.
trump card.cn: 她通过向投资者透露秘密投资计划，打出了自己的王牌。

tunnel vision.en: His tunnel vision prevented him from noticing the approaching danger.
tunnel vision.cn: 他目光如隧道般狭窄，未能察觉逼近的危险。

turkey shoot.en: It was an easy task, like a turkey shoot for the experienced team.
turkey shoot.cn: 对经验丰富的团队来说，这是一项轻而易举的任务，就像打火鸡比赛一样。

turning point.en: The promotion marked a turning point in her career.
turning point.cn: 这次提升标志着她事业上的转折点。

ultra vires.en: The judge ruled the executive's action ultra vires, as it exceeded statutory authority.
ultra vires.cn: 法官裁定该行政官员的行为越权，因其超越了法定权限。

universal grammar.en: Chomsky argued that universal grammar exists in all human infants.
universal grammar.cn: 乔姆斯基认为，普遍语法存在于所有人类婴儿之中。

universal indicator.en: The universal indicator turned purple, confirming the solution was highly alkaline.
universal indicator.cn: 石蕊试液变紫，证实该溶液呈强碱性。

urban myth.en: The story about the haunted subway is just an urban myth with no factual basis.
urban myth.cn: 关于鬼魂地铁的故事纯属都市传说，毫无事实依据。

venture capital.en: Venture capital firms often take significant risks to support innovative startups in emerging markets.
venture capital.cn: 风险投资公司常承担重大风险以支持新兴市场的创新初创企业。

vested interest.en: They have a vested interest in keeping the club as exclusive as possible.
vested interest.cn: 他们希望俱乐部尽可能地限制会员加入以从中受益。

vicious circle.en: The company's financial losses created a vicious circle that proved impossible to break.
vicious circle.cn: 公司的财务亏损形成了一个无法打破的恶性循环。

viral marketing.en: The viral marketing campaign spread rapidly across social media platforms.
viral marketing.cn: 该病毒式营销活动迅速在各大社交媒体平台传播。

virtual memory.en: The server utilized virtual memory to handle the massive influx of data requests efficiently.
virtual memory.cn: 服务器利用虚拟内存高效处理海量数据请求。

virtuous circle.en: This positive feedback creates a virtuous cycle that accelerates our team's productivity.
virtuous circle.cn: 这种正向反馈形成了良性循环，提升了团队的生产力。

visible minority.en: As a visible minority, she often faces unique challenges in the workplace.
visible minority.cn: 作为少数族裔，她在职场常面临独特挑战。

vital sign.en: The patient's vital signs remained stable despite the severe trauma.
vital sign.cn: 尽管遭受严重创伤，该患者的生命体征仍保持稳定。

vitreous humour.en: The surgeon carefully removed the vitreous humour to repair the damaged retina.
vitreous humour.cn: 外科医生小心地摘除玻璃体以修复受损的黄斑区。

viva voce.en: The professor insisted on viva voce examinations to ensure students truly understood the material.
viva voce.cn: 该教授坚持进行口试，以确保学生真正掌握了课程内容。

vote of confidence.en: The board cast a vote of confidence in the new CEO's leadership abilities.
vote of confidence.cn: 董事会对新首席执行官的领导能力表示信任。

vote of no confidence.en: The parliament passed a vote of no confidence, forcing the government to resign immediately.
vote of no confidence.cn: 议会通过对政府的不信任案，迫使政府立即辞职。

vote of thanks.en: The audience gave the speaker a standing vote of thanks for his inspiring performance.
vote of thanks.cn: 观众起立鼓掌，以感谢他精彩的表演。

wagon train.en: The wagon train struggled through the snow, with horses pulling heavy loads.
wagon train.cn: 马车队艰难地穿过积雪，马匹拉着沉重的货物。

wake-up call.en: I asked for a wake-up call at 6.30 a.m.
wake-up call.cn: 我请他们在早晨 6:30 打电话叫醒我。

walking papers.en: The company issued walking papers to the manager after he failed to meet quarterly targets.
walking papers.cn: 该公司在经理未能达成季度目标后向其发出解雇通知。

war chest.en: The government tapped its war chest to fund the emergency relief program.
war chest.cn: 政府动用储备资金资助紧急救援计划。

war crime.en: The court ruled that the systematic torture was a war crime committed during the conflict.
war crime.cn: 法院裁定，系统性酷刑是在冲突期间犯下的战争罪行。

war gaming.en: We should engage in war gaming to test our strategy before the actual conflict begins.
war gaming.cn: 我们应在实际冲突发生前开展战争推演以检验战略。

water cooler.en: It was a story they'd shared around the water cooler.
water cooler.cn: 这件事成为他们工作之余闲聊的谈资。

weapon of mass destruction.en: The alleged weapon of mass destruction was never found, leading to a major diplomatic crisis.
weapon of mass destruction.cn: 所谓大规模杀伤性武器从未被发现，导致了一场重大的外交危机。

weasel word.en: The politician used a weasel word to obscure the true meaning of his controversial proposal.
weasel word.cn: 该政客使用含混措辞来掩盖其争议性提案的真实含义。

welfare state.en: The welfare state provides comprehensive social security for all citizens.
welfare state.cn: 福利制度为所有公民提供全面的社会保障。

well advised.en: You would be well advised to tackle this problem urgently.
well advised.cn: 你还是抓紧处理这个问题为好。

well appointed.en: The newly renovated office is well appointed with modern furniture and state-of-the-art technology.
well appointed.cn: 新装修的办公室配备了现代家具和尖端技术。

well connected.en: The city is well connected by an extensive network of modern public transport.
well connected.cn: 该市拥有广泛的现代公共交通网络，交通十分便利。

well dressed.en: This is what today's well-dressed man is wearing.
well dressed.cn: 这是当今时髦男子的穿着。

well founded.en: His fear turned out to be well founded.
well founded.cn: 他的恐惧证明是有道理的。

well heeled.en: The well-heeled investors quickly bought up all the available shares.
well heeled.cn: 财力雄厚的投资者迅速买光了所有可得的股份。

well informed.en: She is well informed about the latest developments in the tech industry.
well informed.cn: 她深知科技行业的最新动态。

well rounded.en: She is well-rounded, possessing both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills.
well rounded.cn: 她综合素质良好，兼具专业技术能力与出色的人际交往技巧。

well thumbed.en: She had well-thumbed copies of every book on the subject.
well thumbed.cn: 她手头都有该领域每本书的熟读版本。

wet blanket.en: His constant criticism made him feel like a wet blanket at the party.
wet blanket.cn: 他不断的批评让他觉得自己在聚会上像个闷罐子。

white elephant.en: The new office block has become an expensive white elephant.
white elephant.cn: 这座新办公大楼成了昂贵的摆设。

white noise.en: The white noise from the fan helped me focus on my studies.
white noise.cn: 风扇的白色噪音帮助我集中注意力学习。

wild card.en: The new technology acts as a wild card, disrupting established market dynamics.
wild card.cn: 这项新技术犹如一张王牌，扰乱了既有的市场格局。

wild goose chase.en: Don't waste your time on this wild goose chase; the evidence is completely inconclusive.
wild goose chase.cn: 别在这无头绪的调查上浪费时间了，证据完全无法定论。

wind chill.en: Take the wind-chill factor into account.

window dressing.en: The reforms are seen as window dressing.
window dressing.cn: 这些改革被视为是装饰门面。

wire fraud.en: The company suffered heavy losses due to a complex wire fraud scheme involving multiple international accounts.
wire fraud.cn: 该公司因涉及多个国际账户的复杂电信诈骗案遭受重大损失。

wire service.en: The wire service reported that the government had announced new economic policies.
wire service.cn: 通讯社报道，政府已宣布新的经济政策。

wise guy.en: Don't call me a wise guy; I'm just making things complicated for everyone.
wise guy.cn: 别叫我聪明人；我只是让大家都陷入了麻烦。

wishful thinking.en: I've got a feeling that Alex likes me, but that might just be wishful thinking.
wishful thinking.cn: 我有一种感觉:亚历克斯喜欢我。但那可能只是剃头挑子一头热。

witching hour.en: During the witching hour, she felt an overwhelming urge to call her estranged brother.
witching hour.cn: 在午夜时分，她感到一股强烈的冲动，想要给那个疏远的哥哥打电话。

withholding tax.en: The company paid a significant withholding tax on the foreign investor's dividend payments.
withholding tax.cn: 该公司对境外投资者的股息支付征收了高额预提税。

women's studies.en: The university launched a new women's studies program to address historical gender biases in academia.
women's studies.cn: 该校推出了一项新的妇女研究项目，以纠正学术界的历史性别偏见。

wooden spoon.en: He was awarded the wooden spoon, meaning he finished last in his class.
wooden spoon.cn: 他得了木勺奖，意味着他在班级中成绩垫底。

working capital.en: The company secured a loan to boost its working capital for the upcoming expansion project.
working capital.cn: 该公司获得贷款以充实营运资金，用于即将开始的扩建项目。

working paper.en: The committee will review the working paper before finalizing the policy.
working paper.cn: 委员会将在制定政策前审查工作文件。

working party.en: The committee formed a working party to investigate the recent security breaches.
working party.cn: 委员会成立了一个工作组，以调查近期的安全漏洞。

works council.en: The works council actively negotiated the new safety protocols with management.
works council.cn: 工会积极与管理层协商新的安全规程。

wow factor.en: If you want to sell your house quickly, it needs a wow factor.
wow factor.cn: 若想很快把房子卖掉,就得找个卖点。

writer's block.en: The writer's block finally broke after he read a compelling story.
writer's block.cn: 他读完一个引人入胜的故事后，创作瓶颈终于被打破了。

yellow card.en: The referee showed a yellow card to the player for unsporting behavior.
yellow card.cn: 主裁判因该球员行为不端出示黄牌。

yellow journalism.en: The tabloid's sensationalist yellow journalism fueled public outrage over the scandal.
yellow journalism.cn: 该小报煽情式的黄色新闻助长了公众对丑闻的愤慨。

zero tolerance.en: The school enforces a zero-tolerance policy on bullying to ensure every student feels safe.
zero tolerance.cn: 学校实行零容忍欺凌政策，确保每位学生感到安全。

zero-sum game.en: The debate quickly turned into a zero-sum game where one party's gain is the other's loss.
zero-sum game.cn: 这场辩论迅速演变成零和博弈，一方的所得即另一方的所失。
